title: Break between discs and joking about Fig Newtons
summary: Between the CDs, a joke about the Smithsonian recording him eating a Fig Newton.

blocks.x: …I don’t mind if in perpetuity, if people see me eating a Fig Newton, man. It’s cool. Because it’s Smithsonian, it’s cool. Ken: We love Fig Newtons.
You know what I’m saying, you know? If our technology and shit is around a hundred and fifty years from now they will be going, “What is that thing he’s eating?” This is a Fig Newton. Yum. Very good.
Nutritious. Ken: We collected Crispy Cream for the museum.
My god. I’m not saying that…. No way is a Fig Newton nearly as nutritious as a Crispy Cream donut. (laughter in background)
Take everything you hear with a grain of salt. (more laughter) So we can pick up where we left off….
Crispy Cream donuts. Reporting gastric by-passes for a hundred years. (laughter) OK, Mr. Brown.
